time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (x right, y down), seconds; no metric scale estimated
view: straight top-down (nadir) view of a garden yard; the bird flies in a horizontal plane parallel to the image; ground objects at a lower depth than the bird (bird is above ground, its shadow is offset to the left)

camera.evidence: median background of 11 frames is sharp; static objects do not move between frames 0 and 60 (checked visually)

bird.description: large dark crow/raven-like bird (black-grey wings, light grey fan tail, dark beak), seen from above with wings spread and flapping; the only moving object
bird.reference_point: x,y = body centre (midpoint of beak tip and tail tip on the body line); body_x = beak_x - 65 (robust alternative where the tail is merged with the shadow); cx,cy = mask centroid
bird.heading: always flying toward +x (image right), body line horizontal at y ~ 1107-1115

wingspan_px_across_body (bbox_h / span_p.note: flapping: span oscillates with a period of ~16-17 video frames

bird.motion_summary_px_per_frame: beak-tip step ~7-8 px/frame at frames 1-4, rising steadily to ~18-20 px/frame by frame ~16-20, roughly constant ~19-20 px/frame frames 20-45, then decreasing to ~13 px/frame (47-51) and ~7-9 px/frame (52-60)
bird.frame_spacing_anomalies: double-size steps (~36-42 px instead of ~18-20) between frames 18->19 and 42->43: the video appears to drop a source frame there (61 frames at 22.925 fps vs. likely 64 source frames at 24 fps; a third drop is probably in frames 50-58 where the step is small and noisy)

bird_shadow.description: bird-shaped dark green shadow on the ground, offset left (and slightly down) of the bird; only visible on sunlit ground
bird_shadow.visible_frames: partly from ~frame 2, clearly separate frames 28-46, fades into shaded grass by frame 50
bird_shadow.offset_from_bird_centroid_px: when the whole shadow is on sunlit ground (frames 30-36) shadow centroid - bird centroid ~ (-142, +30); at other frames the visible part of the shadow is clipped by the tree-shade boundary (on its left side early, right side late), so the centroid offset is not meaningful (listed values -17..-256 px in x)

wooden_shed.desc: wooden plank shed/hut roof seen from above, top-centre-left; crossed eave beams at its lower edge

barrels.desc: two wooden barrels side by side under the shed eave

crate_steps.desc: stacked wooden crates / steps below the shed door

white_flower_bush.desc: small white-flower bush on ground above the bird's start

lilac_flower_bush.desc: blue/lilac-flower bush right of centre; the bird flies past just below/over it at the end

wooden_cart.desc: wooden hand cart lower right (box body + two wheels + two handles pointing left)

wooden_fence.desc: rustic wooden fence running from the top edge (x~1560-1650) down then diagonally to (1330, 878)

hedge.desc: green hedge/bush at the left edge

ground.desc: grass with dappled tree shadows (dark green) and sunlit patches (yellow); no markings

events.event: bird visible at start, flying right, wings fully spread (max span)
apparent double step (dropped source frame between 18 and 19)
bird reaches cruising speed ~19-20 px/frame (accelerating before)
apparent double step (dropped source frame between 42 and 43)
bird starts slowing down; enters shaded grass near the lilac bush
last frame; bird still flying right at ~8-11 px/frame
